exceptions.why: pnpm reads its hook file only under this exact name, and only as CommonJS, so it cannot be .ts
ESLint reads a TypeScript config only through `jiti`, which this repository does not install, so the flat config stays `.js` (#4274)

the test page's own script, which `serve.ts` hands to a BROWSER unchanged: a browser cannot load `.ts` (no type stripping, and this fixture has no build step), so it is served as `.js`; the page's `index.html` names it by this path (#5011, #4084)

a THIRD-PARTY build, not our source: `@auth0/auth0-spa-js` 2.28.3 (MIT), the package's `dist/auth0-spa-js.production.js` byte for byte after one added first-line eslint-disable directive (sha256 pinned in `serve.test.ts`); it is minified, browser-loaded and cannot be `.ts`, and vendoring it means the page has no CDN dependency (#5011, #4084)

a PACKAGE FILE of an isolation fixture: `packages/guards/src/isolation-gate.ts` packs the fixture and installs the tarball into a throwaway consumer, so this file runs from that consumer's `node_modules/`.
